summary: Distinguish intentional suspension from unhealthy delivery in per-agent metrics

replay.detail: No graph replay or durable state changes.

schema.detail: No persisted schema, API or generated-client changes.

rules.detail: Read-only telemetry uses suspension::current(...).holds_seat(), the same authoritative lifecycle fold as the reconciler, not harness or runtime liveness. Shared locally owned agent membership is unchanged; stopped declarations emit no series.

compatibility.detail: The st3 meter's st.delivery.state_age gauge adds bounded attribute st.agent.desired=running|suspended. Suspension includes active suspend/resume holds until resume completes. No stopped or unknown value is exported. Existing state, reason, identity and age semantics remain unchanged; changing desired state does not reset delivery age.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon rollout; no migration or backfill.

manual.detail: Delivery stale alerts should select st.delivery.state=stale AND st.agent.desired=running AND st.delivery.state_age > 600 seconds. Apply the same desired-running filter to refused-delivery alerts if configured.

recovery.detail: The existing off-scrape cache refreshes desired-state attributes; scrape callbacks do no Store reads.
